to1M.howItWorks: The override gives the whole rope block as "rope_scaling" (the field in transformers 4, an alias of rope_parameters in transformers 5) at the level where config.json has it (top level or text_config, which vLLM v0.31.0 and SGLang v0.5.21 merge into the sub-config), and also sets max_position_embeddings to 1,048,576: vLLM v0.31.0 does not multiply max_position_embeddings by a YaRN factor, and SGLang v0.5.21 does not either when original_max_position_embeddings is present, so without it both reject --max-model-len/--context-length 1048576.
